author: LightPacker621535
comment: Really enjoyed our stay at this beautiful boutique hotel, super position on Palmar beach, quiet and relaxed.The food is excellent, no buffets here everything is made to order and Sanjay and the team always have a smile to welcome you for breakfast.The giant prawn curry comes with my highest recommendation and the executive chef has offered to send me home with the recipe.Planning on coming back with the whole family 😊Read more

author: Tom M
comment: Incredible views, amazing food and friendly staff, would definitely recommendThe resort provided so much we never felt the need to go anywhere else.With their ocean activities, occasional entertainers and number of different locations to relax by the pool or the ocean we were never left wantingRead more

author: Chirag M
comment: We went to Salt of Palmar Mauritius, for our honeymoon based on the recommendations we saw on TripAdvisor and we could not be more glad with our decision. It was beyond what we expected and worth every penny we spent. As soon as you enter the Resort doors, you see the brightly colored walls, the pool, and then the Ocean right in front of you. You cannot ask for a better view IMHO. The hotel lacks of a conventional Front Desk, which makes the experience of dealing with the staff more cozy. Salt has a private beach surrounded with cool spots to relax by, a helpful staff that is there to address all your needs, its own boathouse for water activities, a relaxing spa,  special experiences for Honeymooners, and much more. We would recommend exploring the hotel on your first day We would like to highlight some staff members, Preethika, Akash, Akshaye and Qwelyn, who went above and beyond to service us and make our experience pleasant.Read more

author: Resort17117409232
comment: Our stay was amazing One of the best hotels I've been in my life Special thanks for the stuff that was more then awesome, especially Sanjay that made our stay fantastic, he is definitely one of a kindThe beach is amazingEverything is clean and shiny Sure we'll come back!Read more

author: Rob Battes
comment: Salt of Palmar is a fantastic destination. Staff very friendly and attentive. No TV in the room, but an excellent DAB radio. Wonderful without TV. You will be welcomed like a prince. we would like to mention someone in particular, Mr Med. they knew we had been married for 50 years. And we knew that. From the moment we entered we were put in the spotlight. room decorated, cocktail making workshop.(The boy from the rooftop bar👍) And finally we were taken from the table and taken to the beach. a beach house there was decorated especially for us. our dinner was brought there. The chef kook made a special cake for us. Never to be forgotten. We will never forget this beautiful small-scale resort and we can recommend it to everyone. We would like to thank everyone for this unforgettable experience. chapeau.❤️Rob and Ann BattesTheNetherlandsRead more

author: Christina C
comment: We stayed here for 12 nights. The hotel truly offers everything we had imagined. The à la carte breakfast is very diverse and extremely delicious. All the service staff are always eager to fulfill every wish and are very friendly. In particular, Sanjay takes great joy in his work. The rooms are very beautiful, clean, and the beds are extremely comfortable. The dinner has also always been very delicious.Read more

author: Culture30419933206
comment: 5-Stars for SALT of Palmar, Mauritius!From the moment we arrived at SALT of Palmar, we felt like cherished guests in a hidden paradise. The entire experience was flawless, thanks to the incredible team who went above and beyond to make our stay unforgettable. Every single staff member was friendly, attentive, and eager to help, addressing us by name and genuinely caring about every aspect of our comfort. They couldn't have done more for us, and each interaction was met with a warm smile.The hotel itself is immaculate—spotlessly clean with a soothing fragrance throughout. It truly feels like an oasis, a sanctuary for couples seeking intimacy and exclusivity. With only 60 rooms, the atmosphere is serene and personal, allowing you to feel as if you have the entire place to yourselves.The on-site chefs are phenomenal; every meal was a culinary delight, prepared to perfection. The kitchen staff each morning were particularly outstanding, ensuring we began every day with an amazing breakfast experience. The pool was kept at the perfect temperature, providing a refreshing dip that we looked forward to daily.The rooms are thoughtfully designed, with luxurious showers and breathtaking views onto the beach that make you feel connected to the stunning landscape of Mauritius. We loved waking up each morning to such a beautiful scene—it was pure bliss. The hotel is also situated on the east coast which allows you the catch the most amazing view of the sunrise if you wake up early enough.A huge thank you to the entire team at SALT of Palmar for their exceptional hospitality. The staff members in particular who went above and beyond were - Akash, Rewa, Med, Shirley, Sanjay, Bhishav, Prince, Qwelyn, Ved and Dervin. This hotel is a gem, and I couldn’t recommend it more. If you’re looking for an intimate, personalized, and genuinely magical stay, this is the place to be.Thank you for an unforgettable experience!Warm Regards - SafRead more

author: Sanj L
comment: Was there on 01 November 2024 with my wife. Everything was perfect ranging from the courteous staff to the cosy room. Food was just perfect. Do not expect dinner buffet. Dinner is a la carte. Hotel was celebrating its 6 years anniversary when we were there. Kudos to Sanjay, Med, Vish, Vikish and chefs Yannick and Shiva for making our stay a memorable one. Definitely recommended for a weekend get away. Will be back soon.Read more

author: Harsah I
comment: Wonderful staff and always very courteous and welcoming. Food and drinks were on top.. Thanks a lot to chef yanick, chef shiva, sanjay, med, vish, vikish and whole team. Room very cosy. Will definitely recommend and be back again very soon.Read more

author: Haley R
comment: After staying at a large scale resort on the west side of the island, salt was SUCH a treat. The beach is absolutely stunning and the staff makes it feel like home. Sanjay and Med helped us for most meals and were so kind and friendly. Kenny helped me train at the gym offering a lovely personalized workout for climbing Kilimanjaro soon. Bavash one of the bartenders was offered implacable service. 10/10 would recommend and come back!Read more

author: Adnan...
comment: Fantastic hotel, good location and good staff. They have a beautiful view of the sea and a lovely pool. the room is a nice size and very clean andThe menu varies and they have very good food. We had the most contact with SanjayHe talked to us and recommended us places we should visit. 10 out of 10 customer serviceRead more

author: Daniel
comment: Stunning location and facilities. Great value for money and friendly service. a very well maintained venue with some great design features. The rooms overlooking the ocean, what a treat. The wine selection could do with a bit of work, the price and quality don't quite match. The food was good but with some minor adjustments could be excellent. Over all an amazing stay.Read more

author: w0rldwidew0man
comment: My husband and I stayed at Salt Hotel in early September and it was our first visit to Mauritius. In our stay with Salt, we experienced a high level of service, comfort, delicious cuisine and activities in one package. Everything was exemplary and we cannot fault anything.The room had an incredible view (Best on beach).  It was very clean, comfortable and practical. The showers are a joy here and we enjoyed a spa-like experience every time. The bed and bedding was the most comfortable we have experienced. There was plenty on offer, whether lazing by the pool or participating in water activities such as snorkelling, pedal boating etc.  There is a lovely stretch of beach for walking.We went for the half board option and meals here were amazing! Breakfast was an excellent start to the day and dinners were a lovely affair. We ate so very well and the Chef was really nice to check up on guests after dinner for feedback and a lovely chat.I think that the best part of our stay was the genuine warmth of the staff who are a real asset to the resort and great ambassadors for the brand. From when we were first greeted at reception, Pratheeka made us feel welcomed and looked after and always made sure to ask how our day was every time we saw her. A big shout out to Rajiv, Bool, Shib, Ved and Derwin for great service in the dining room. Also to Babish at the rooftop bar for delicious cocktails. Thank you to Dev the driver and Mr Gutty (our cab driver) for such fun excursions. Our two spa attendants on Sept 18 (apologies we did not get your names but your hands are magic!) Also to Mallini for keeping the room exceptionally clean and tidy.  Lastly, to Rishi, one of the managers who is a really top guy as he made sure everything during our stay was perfect from giving us advice with the best excursion options and arranging appointments at the spa.  We felt very looked after by him and we are very grateful. In summary, we cannot recommend Salt highly enough for a luxurious tropical getaway and we hope to be back again.Read more

author: Purplelove007
comment: Wonderful warm welcome to this uniquely decorated, beautiful hotel. Amazing staff throughout whole stay. Food was always extremely well presented and delicious. Sun beds, bean bags, hammocks and beach towels all perfect and comfortable. We had bang on the beach room, which was stunning, it was cleaned spotlessly daily, fantastic sea views. No fridge in room which was disappointing. We had bed and breakfast, which had great choices and always extremely tasty.Food and drink at hotel was very high priced, which meant we ate out more, or bought items back to our room. We noted even if full board or all inclusive some things were not included in price, eg smoothies. Was very windy on beach, but if you take a sun bed or bean bag round the corner on beach, wind drops and it’s restful.Read more

author: Jai & Khay
comment: Mersi & Enkosi to an amazing Salt of Palmer team! We have traveled as global citizens and Loyal Marriott Bonvoy Members for years in North and Central America and Asia; truthfully, your Hospitality was some of the best in the world. After our stay, we are excited to share our 5-star experience with our colleagues and loved ones worldwide. Special shoutout to Shib, Vikesh, Kesh, Mr. Bool, Med, Dharam, Kenny, Naina, Sanjay, Rewa, Raju, Lurvish, Roshan, Pradesh, and Anu who cared for us like family. We will be back; if you are an environmentalist, advocate for Local community investments and conscious traveler I highly recommend SALT!Truly,Jai & Khay Sigula-Stephens FamilyRead more

author: David T
comment: The hotel is in an excellent position on the east coast You could walk for a long way on the beach, often bumping into people riding horses.The food was excellent and all the staff were friendly and helpful especially Sanjay. The swimming pool was very inviting and we used it most days.There was always sunbeds available, but not always round the pool.We used the rooftop bar, from which the views were very good(especially looking at the Fruit bats at dusk).Read more

author: Mike A
comment: We’ve thoroughly enjoyed our time at SALT - the hotel itself offers fab decor and lovely clean and spacious rooms. Located on a beautiful stretch of white sandy beach, there’s great snorkelling at your fingertips. The hotel provides loads of information from a guidebook to a tailor-made app to make the whole island accessible and we’ve really loved exploring everything Mauritus has to offer by hire car.We’re particularly grateful to all of the wonderful staff, the whole team here at SALT are really friendly and approachable and have all gone out of their way to make sure our stay was as comfortable as possible. We’ve also been really impressed by the food - the menu is expansive and includes a fab array of traditional Mauritian food, lovely fresh fish and octopus, and a great range of vegan/vegetarian dishes. We’d recommend trying to sample everything they have to offer while you’re here!We’d love to come back and unwind here once again soon and explore more of the wonderful island in the future.Thanks team SALT!Read more

author: Jean Laurent P
comment: We spent 4 days at the salt of palmar for our honeymoon. The service was impeccable, the food out of this world and the view on the ocean breathtaking. The salt is a uniquely designed and decorated hotel, with class and beauty everywhere. Every detail is taken care of and the customer experience is a priority. This is really a 5 star hotel. Definitely recommend!Read more

author: Dave D
comment: We stayed at Salt for three days as part of a longer tour of Mauritius and to be honest I now with that we had booked it for longer and used it as a base. A wonderful hotel.Service: The staff were, without exception, a wonderful group of people. They went out of their way to make sure that our stay was comfortable. Friendly, efficient and attentive.Location: Fabulous. Book a sea view room if you can.Food: Fantastic. Great local and fresh options for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Good drinks selection (and a generous pour if you opt for a glass rather than a bottle!)Overall, we had a lovely stay at the Salt and I would be happy to recommend it to anyone. Looking forward to our next stay!Read more
